manual.question: Is the status or error message understandable on its own, without seeing where it appeared?
manual.procedure: Trigger it; read/listen to the message in isolation.
manual.why: A message that only makes sense visually is not a status message for everyone.

manual.question: Is the icon recognisable and, where it conveys meaning, is its name meaningful in this context?
manual.procedure: Compare the icon with its accessible name and with what a sighted user sees.
manual.why: Automated tools cannot judge whether a name is meaningful.

manual.question: Review the engine results marked as needing review; they are not passes.
manual.procedure: Read the incomplete results and decide each one.
manual.why: An incomplete engine result is a question, not a clean result.

manual.question: Does a screen reader announce anything unnecessarily repetitive at this state?
manual.procedure: Use a real screen reader (not a simulation) and listen.
manual.why: Repetition and verbosity are quality barriers automated tools cannot measure.

limits: Chromium only. A different engine or browser would build different evidence; nothing here is extrapolated to them.
Automated results are a DRAFT: a clean scan is not an accessibility pass. The manual checks in this record were not performed by a person unless a result says so.
